body: Left over from PR 136 (the 'Songs without an album' display rule), all small: the Library sorts the bucket by its raw name '[Unknown Album]', so it lands at the top of an A-Z list; searching 'unknown' still finds the bucket; the song menu still offers 'Go to album' for a song that now shows no album (harmless, the page exists). Row R2-F3 in docs/tasks/AUDIT.md.
